beats.headline: A ring for a pig
beats.text: The chamber inside Scolopendra has no air, and the splooge does not help. Penelope struggles and a health bar appears. Carl applies an anti-oxygen-deprivation potion to himself but stops before giving her one: her constitution is three, and a second potion too soon would poison her. Then an item in his inventory catches his eye, from the pile of jewellery Mistress Tiatha set aside, taken from previous crawlers. A nipple ring called Petey Motteux's Little Secret. He did not want it, and Donut refused it; it was too big for her to eat. It grants Oxygenated, and Bawdy, which marks bars, dance halls and chocolate houses on a map.
beats.gist: Penelope struggles for air, and Carl notices a nipple ring that grants Oxygenated.

beats.headline: Pierced, and too late
beats.text: It is the only choice they have. Carl shoves the empty gun into the fancy holster, reaches forward until he feels a nipple on the pig, and installs the ring by piercing her flesh. A new achievement flashes as Penny squeals in surprised pain. Then Mordecai writes that splooge is a type of potion but is treated more like a food-based buff, so the cooldown rules do not apply. Now you tell me, says Carl. I just pierced a pig's nipple.
beats.gist: Carl pierces Penny's nipple with the ring, and Mordecai then says the cooldown rules never applied.

relations.note: the splooge gave no air; the ring did
